{
  "project_id": "P-NGA-AgroProcessingLivelihood",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Unretired travel advances and inadequate expenditure documentation within PFMUs and FPFMD could lead to ineligible expenses and fiduciary delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement an enhanced accountability framework in the Financial Procedures Manual, enforce strict advance acquittal controls, and conduct risk-based internal audits.",
      "evidence": "The key issues noted within the PFMUs and FPFMD are unretired advances and inadequate documentation of the eligible expenditures incurred."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "State-level implementation capacity limitations and multi-layered bureaucratic approval processes may cause operational delays across participating states.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Contract qualified third-party implementation support, deploy standardized Project Implementation Manuals, and utilize performance-based funding allocations.",
      "evidence": "Taking the lessons learnt from the implementation of CADP... addressing capacity limitations, Coalitions/participation of beneficiaries, avoiding delays in approval processes"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Project economic and financial returns are highly sensitive to market output price drops, where a 20 percent reduction turns NPV negative.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Facilitate structured business alliances with off-takers, construct aggregation/storage infrastructure to smooth price fluctuations, and establish market information platforms.",
      "evidence": "One can safely conclude that the project is highly robust to increase in prices of inputs (cost) while being sensitive to a reduction in output prices"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Agricultural intensification and small-scale civil works may cause localized soil and water contamination, waste generation, or runoff pollution.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply site-specific Environmental and Social Management Plans, enforce the Integrated Pest Management Plan, and designate dedicated environmental specialists.",
      "evidence": "agricultural intensification involving the use of inputs, could potentially have adverse impact on soil, water and vegetation covers."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Infrastructure developments such as access roads and processing units may require land acquisition, causing involuntary resettlement or loss of resource access.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Execute site screening under the Resettlement Policy Framework (RPF) and implement transparent Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs) including full asset compensation.",
      "evidence": "Involuntary re-settlement (OP/BP 4.12)... infrastructure investments could result in involuntary re-settlement and land requisition."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Low procurement capacity in participating states and mandatory contract approvals at executive level risk significant procurement bottlenecks.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Retain procurement execution in dedicated NCO/SCO units, competitively recruit experienced procurement officers and consultants, and conduct annual procurement audits.",
      "evidence": "The procurement capacity is still considered low and most of the states do not have procurement tools in place."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Targeted smallholder farmers may slowly adopt or reject new climate-smart and nutrition-sensitive agricultural technologies.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide matching grant incentives under Sub-component 1.3, conduct technology field demonstrations, and deliver targeted agricultural extension services.",
      "evidence": "Productivity has not shown any significant enhancement due to under-investment in new technologies, slow adoption of existing improved technologies by producers"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Business alliances between farmer cooperatives and private buyers may fail due to side-selling, weak contract enforcement, or unequal negotiation power.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted technical assistance for alliance structuring, business plan development, commercial arbitration, and cooperative management capacity building.",
      "evidence": "weak market negotiation ability of small producers vis-à-vis buyers and input providers... inability of buyers and sellers to successfully integrate"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Regional insecurity and militant activities in intervention areas could disrupt civil works, supply chains, and project field activities.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Include state police representation on State Technical Committees, continuously monitor local security conditions, and maintain flexible state funding allocations.",
      "evidence": "compounded by additional factors including a sharp drop in oil production levels due to militant activities in the Niger Delta region."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Socio-cultural constraints may restrict women and youth from accessing land, capital, inputs, and project matching grants.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a dedicated Women and Youth Empowerment sub-component (Sub-component 2.1) providing start-up grants, mentorship, and monitoring via a gender tracker.",
      "evidence": "women in Nigeria, compared with men, have relatively limited access to productive agricultural land, inputs and services."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Delays by participating states in executing legal subsidiary agreements could hold back project effectiveness and initial credit disbursements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Sequence project start-up across six pre-assessed ready states and deploy dedicated legal support to streamline subsidiary agreement execution.",
      "evidence": "At least one Subsidiary Agreement has been executed on behalf of the Recipient and one Participating State and has been duly authorized or ratified"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Processing assets, aggregation facilities, and rural infrastructure may degrade quickly if local beneficiaries fail to fund and perform maintenance.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Mandate established management structures and 100% beneficiary O&M cost-coverage commitments prior to investing in subproject infrastructure.",
      "evidence": "the project will first establish a management structure and O&M arrangement for each infrastructure before investing in such undertakings."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Supply of counterfeit or low-quality agricultural inputs in the market may undermine productivity gains and cause crop failure.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide technical assistance to FMARD and regulatory agencies to enforce quality assurance, accredit input dealers, and inform farmers on certified suppliers.",
      "evidence": "support to FMARD and other relevant agencies in conducting assessment of government policies and capacity strengthening on quality control of agro-inputs"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Unretired travel advances and inadequate expenditure documentation within PFMUs and FPFMD could lead to ineligible expenses and fiduciary delays.
risks.mitigation: Implement an enhanced accountability framework in the Financial Procedures Manual, enforce strict advance acquittal controls, and conduct risk-based internal audits.
risks.evidence: The key issues noted within the PFMUs and FPFMD are unretired advances and inadequate documentation of the eligible expenditures incurred.
